speaker: Foggy
text: Hi, Alex.

speaker: Foggy
text: I'm Foggy, your AI recovery companion from CloudCare.

speaker: Foggy
text: I'm checking in on behalf of your care team.

speaker: Foggy
text: How are you feeling since getting home?

speaker: Patient
text: A little tired, and my shoulder is starting to hurt more.

speaker: Foggy
text: On a scale of 1 to 10, with 10 being the worst pain you can imagine, how would you rate it?

speaker: Patient
text: About a six.

speaker: Foggy
text: Has that improved, stayed the same, or gotten worse?

speaker: Patient
text: Worse.

speaker: Patient
text: It was about a three earlier.

speaker: Foggy
text: Have you been able to follow the pain medication instructions your care team gave you?

speaker: Patient
text: I'm confused about the schedule.

speaker: Patient
text: I don't remember when I last took anything.

speaker: Foggy
text: Thanks for telling me.

speaker: Foggy
text: Are you having trouble breathing, chest pain, or any other new symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: No, just the shoulder pain.

speaker: Foggy
text: Because your pain is increasing and your medication timing is unclear, I'm flagging this for your care team to review.

speaker: Foggy
text: Please contact them using the on-call number in your discharge instructions so they can clarify your next steps.

speaker: Patient
text: Can you tell them what's happening?

speaker: Foggy
text: Yes.

speaker: Foggy
text: Your report includes pain increasing from three to six, uncertainty about your last medication dose, and no other symptoms reported.

speaker: Foggy
text: It will appear in their review queue.

speaker: Foggy
text: It hasn't been acknowledged yet.

speaker: Patient
text: Can you share that with Sam too?

speaker: Foggy
text: Just confirming, is this the Sam listed as your emergency contact?

speaker: Foggy
text: If so, I'll go ahead and share it with your permission.

speaker: Patient
text: Yes, please do.

speaker: Foggy
text: Shared.

speaker: Foggy
text: Is there anything else you need, Alex?

speaker: Patient
text: I'm all set.

speaker: Foggy
text: I hope you feel better.

speaker: Foggy
text: Take care.
